scientific_role: Distinguish same full cache inventory from same GSI DEM contents actually selected in each frozen chunk
per_chunk_input: exact DEM TIFF returned by unmodified GSI builder before production terrain sampling
digest_rule: stream SHA256 of each actually selected DEM TIFF, combine in ascending integer chunk index with explicit unavailable sentinel; never export per-chunk or per-file digests
